subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should diagnostic stuck-session recovery treat an active model-call abort as a replay-safe model idle timeout while keeping active side-effecting tool and stale recovery out of retry/fallback paths?
rationale: This is an intentional session-state and availability behavior change that green CI cannot fully settle because it changes when failover may retry work after recovery aborts an active run.

options.title: Approve the boundary and land
options.body: Accept the PR's active model-call versus side-effecting-tool split after owner review, then refresh against current main before merge.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep stuck recovery as external abort unless maintainers want an explicit smaller follow-up for active model-call fallback semantics.

options.title: Wait for timing work
options.body: Pause until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98580 or equivalent recovery-timing work settles if maintainers want ordering resolved first.

recommendation.title: Approve the boundary and land
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's active model-call versus side-effecting-tool split after owner review, then refresh against current main before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already framed the required replay-safety distinction in the PR discussion.
